subject: infra.connect
name: National address-protocol migration roadmap
what_would_settle_it: a regulator or ministry decision adopting a dated migration plan would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, coordination is delegated to the domain association but no regulator or ministry decision adopting a dated plan exists; the 2024, 2025 and July 2026 forums are all still calling for one

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National computer emergency response team
what_would_settle_it: a decree creating a national team, or an agency line naming one, would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, a live government site identifies the national team; the creating decree text was not located and the 2024 law names no decree

subject: infra.energy
name: Energy supply for rural telecom sites
what_would_settle_it: a fund or project document specifying site powering would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, no project document specifies site powering for the white-zone programme; the only powering detail anywhere is a reported solar pilot

subject: dpi.exchange
name: National interoperability framework
what_would_settle_it: a prime-ministerial order adopting it would settle it, and this is the central missing object of the exchange layer; probed 2026-08-05, the framework itself is unpublished; the 2024 platform decree refers to it as an existing reference and leaves its adoption to a prime-ministerial order without annexing it

subject: data.statistics
name: National statistics instrument
what_would_settle_it: a statistics law or a strategy document would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the 2021 statistics law is on the statistics office's own site; its three implementing decrees were adopted only in July 2025

subject: gov.legislate
name: Enforcement decrees under the 2021 law
what_would_settle_it: publication of any implementing decree, or its express abrogation, would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, a June 2022 council of ministers communique records adoption of the decree organising the data-protection commission, but the decree text is unpublished and the gazette route is dead

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection authority annual report
what_would_settle_it: publication on the authority's site would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the authority's own annual reports page carries a heading and nothing behind it, so the statutory publication duty is not met on its site

subject: data.open
name: Access to public information law
what_would_settle_it: probed 2026-08-05, the 2015 access to information law located in the broadcasting regulator's text library; the access authority it creates was never stood up for want of an implementing decree

subject: data.open
name: National open-data portal
what_would_settle_it: probed 2026-08-05, the national portal hostname now serves a data-engineering console rather than a public dataset catalogue; a donor-supported mirror still serves datasets; acquisition attempted 2026-08-05 and failed, absence now stated dated on the place hub

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Adult digital-literacy rate
what_would_settle_it: the one financial-education output figure in the base comes from a project that has now closed; probed 2026-08-05, no published rate exists; digital literacy is a stated government priority with no measured baseline attached

subject: include.divides
name: Repeated household access survey
what_would_settle_it: probed 2026-08-05, the harmonised household living conditions survey is the repeated instrument, carrying household ICT access by region and setting across two rounds
